storageDisjointness.proof: Every native HTTP/new DO get/head/put is wrapped at construction by nativeBlobStore. Fixed first path segment native-v2 is disjoint from both fixed legacy first segments att and backup. No list/delete/multipart capability is exposed. Legacy classes and rollback receive the original unwrapped bucket.

retainedReleaseRoute.noWriteEvidence: On this exact path public/authenticated grant mutation routes return without action; Scaffold auth uses read-only authority fetch, or old device /authenticate reads grant storage without put/delete. Release reader requests devstorage.read_only OAuth scope and issues only GCS GET/HEAD. No R2 or session/device namespace operation is reached. OAuth token exchange POST is not a resource/data write.

nativeEpochFence.implementation: src/native-grant-epoch.ts plus shared AuthGrant transitions in src/auth-routes.ts
nativeEpochFence.namespace: Existing NATIVE_AUTH_GRANTS only, exposed internally as activeNativeEnv.NATIVE_GRANT_EPOCHS; no new binding, class, resource or migration
nativeEpochFence.objectName: native-epoch/<JSON tuple of verified ownerUserId, projectId, deploymentId, sessionId, logical sandboxId>
nativeEpochFence.value: Complete scope tuple plus monotonic lifecycleEpoch and exact targetDeviceId for that epoch; no bearer/access secret stored in coordinator
nativeEpochFence.advanceAuthority: Only server-verified profile issuance sets the internal issuer header after verifiedSandboxTarget and ownership checks. No public header is forwarded; direct dev issuance cannot pass verifiedSandboxTarget. Coordinator calls additionally require their deterministic scope object ID, never an ordinary 32-hex grant object ID.
nativeEpochFence.ordering: AuthGrant blockConcurrencyWhile serializes coordinator compare/write operations. Higher verified epochs advance durably; lower epochs and equal-epoch conflicting devices fail closed. Per-grant issue rechecks after local storage so a concurrent newer issue cannot publish an older usable grant. Failed stores never roll the fence back.
nativeEpochFence.consumers: Shared exchange/authenticate/refresh check the current fence before transitions and again after hash/storage awaits. Existing HTTP authentication and socket receive/silent-delivery revalidation inherit this rejection without per-endpoint guards. Missing/corrupt state or authority failures fail closed; checks never create authority.
nativeEpochFence.legacyPreservation: Exact recovered legacy classes/raw env and independent canary do not enable this internal native-only view; their grant records, namespaces and alarms remain unchanged.
nativeEpochFence.linearization: Authorization linearizes at the final coordinator check. Work already authorized before a newer epoch commits is not retroactively retracted; no cross-operation lease/global transaction protocol is claimed.
